sn35.74:1.2: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || la || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.74:1.3: Amukasmim bhante vihāre aññataro bhikkhu navo appaññāto ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno ||
sn35.74:1.4: sādhu bhante Bhagavā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkamatu anukampam upādāyāti || || 4
sn35.74:2.1: Atha kho Bhagavā navakavādañca sutvā gilānavādañca appaññāto bhikkhūti iti viditvā yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami || || 5
sn35.74:2.2: Addasā kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantaṃ dūrato va āgacchantaṃ ||
sn35.74:2.4: Atha kho Bhagavā tam bhikkhum etad avoca || ||
sn35.74:2.8: Nisajja kho Bhagavā tam bhikkhum etad avoca || ||
sn35.74:2.9: Kacci te bhikkhu khamanīyaṃ || kacci yāpanīyaṃ || kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no atikkamanti || patikammosānam paññāyati no abhikkamoti || ||
sn35.74:3.1: Na me bhante khamanīyaṃ na yāpanīyaṃ || bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti || abhikkamosānam paññāyati no paṭikkamoti || || 8
sn35.74:4.1: Kacci te bhikkhu na kiñci kukkuccaṃ na koci vippaṭisāroti || ||
sn35.74:5.1: Taggha me bhante anappakaṃ kukkuccam anappako vippaṭisāroti || || 9
sn35.74:8.1: No ce kira tvam bhikkhu attā sīlato upavadati || atha bhikkhu kismiṃ ca te kukkuccam ko ca vippaṭisāroti || ||
sn35.74:9.1: Na khvāham bhante sīlavisuddhattham Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitam ājānāmīti || || 11
sn35.74:10.1: No ce kira tvam bhikkhu sīlavisuddhattham mayā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāsi || atha kimatthaṃ carahi tvam bhikkhu mayā dhammaṃ desitam ājānāsīti ||
sn35.74:11.1: Rāgavirāgatthaṃ khvāham bhante Bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitam ājānāmīti || || 12
sn35.74:12.2: Sādhu kho tvam bhikkhu rāgavirāgattham mayā dhammaṃ desitam ājānāsi ||
sn35.74:12.3: rāgavirāgattho hi bhikkhu mayā dhammo desito || || 13
sn35.74:14.6: Mano nicco vā anicco vā ti || ||
sn35.74:16.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vā sukhaṃ vā ti || ||
sn35.74:18.1: Yam panāniccaṃ dukkhaṃ viparināmadhammaṃ kallan nu taṃ samanupassituṃ
sn35.74:18.2: Etam mama eso ham asmi eso me attāti || ||
sn35.74:20.1: Evam passam bhikkhu sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmim pi nibbindati ||
sn35.74:21.2: attamano so bhikkhu Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinandi ||
sn35.74:21.3: imasmiṃ ca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne tassa bhikkhuno virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhum udapādi || ||
sn35.74:21.5: [Exacky the same as in the preceding Sutta]
